claims.claim: A general denial is allowed in an unverified limited civil case.
claims.quote: (d) If the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1 or is not verified, a general denial is sufficient but only puts in issue the material allegations of the complaint.
claims.note: This supports the type of denial, not the use of a particular form.

claims.claim: PLD-050 is the short general denial form.
claims.note: The form text was not provided.

claims.claim: PLD-050 may be used in any unverified limited civil case.
claims.note: Section 431.30(d) does not establish form eligibility. The citation description mentions assigned claims over $1,000 but is not the form text.

claims.claim: The limited civil amount-in-controversy ceiling is $35,000, inclusive.
claims.quote: (a) The amount in controversy does not exceed thirty-five thousand dollars ($35,000).
claims.note: The amount in controversy excludes attorneys’ fees, interest, and costs.

claims.claim: A claim of $35,000 or less is, by that fact alone, a limited civil case.
claims.quote: an action or special proceeding shall be treated as a limited civil case only if all of the following conditions are satisfied:
claims.note: The amount ceiling is necessary, not sufficient. Subdivisions (b) and (c) also restrict the relief sought.

claims.claim: A person unable to afford the filing fee may request a fee waiver.
claims.note: No provided text establishes the fee-waiver condition or procedure.

claims.claim: Use form FW-001 to request the waiver.
claims.note: The form text was not provided.

flags.text: “Any” extends statutory permission to make a general denial into an unsupported claim about PLD-050 eligibility, including for assigned claims within the stated scope.
Relying on the unchecked form instruction could lead to a defective response and risk default.
The draft defines limited civil status by dollar amount alone; section 85 requires all its conditions.
Neither named form is provided, and the filing statute does not specify filing with the clerk.
“If you cannot afford the filing fee, ask for a fee waiver on form FW-001” directs the reader to act on an unchecked condition and form.

result.summary: The statutes support timely filing with the court, a general denial for an unverified complaint, and the $35,000 ceiling. They do not establish that PLD-050 is usable throughout the stated scope or support the FW-001 instruction. The amount ceiling alone does not define a limited civil case.
